summary.zh: 在传统街巷与木构语境中植入轻量咖啡空间，以可识别的构件、菜单与细部建立亲切的社区界面。
summary.en: A lightweight cafe intervention uses recognizable components, menus and details to create a friendly community edge within a traditional lane.
